name: Falkland Islands

seo.title: Falkland Islands Voyage by Antarctica21: 10 Days
seo.description: Ten days round trip from Ushuaia aboard Magellan Explorer: New Island, Steeple Jason, Volunteer Point, Sea Lion Island and West Point. April 2028.

tagline: Ten days island hopping the Falklands.
answer: Falklands (Malvinas) is Antarctica21's ten-day, nine-night sea voyage, round trip from Ushuaia aboard Magellan Explorer with up to 96 guests. Six days among the islands take in New Island, Steeple Jason, Saunders, Volunteer Point, Port Stanley, Sea Lion Island, Pebble, Keppel and West Point. The published departure is April 2028.
overview: A short sea voyage focused on Falklands wildlife: albatross, rockhopper and king penguins, elephant seals and sea lions.

hero.alt: Penguin colony on a rocky hillside above a sandy beach and turquoise sea in the Falklands

itinerary.title: Embarkation
itinerary.summary: Board (boarding closes at 16:00) and sail the Beagle Channel.

itinerary.title: New Island and Carcass Island
itinerary.summary: Cliffs and seabird colonies, then Carcass Island's hills and beaches.

itinerary.title: Steeple Jason and Saunders Island
itinerary.summary: Possible landing at a large black browed albatross colony, then king penguins on Saunders.

itinerary.title: Volunteer Point and Port Stanley
itinerary.summary: King penguin colony, then the capital.

itinerary.title: Bleaker Island and Sea Lion Island
itinerary.summary: Birdlife and penguins on Bleaker, elephant seals and sea lions at Bull Point, a sunset transit of Falkland Sound.

itinerary.title: Pebble Island and Keppel Island
itinerary.summary: Birdlife on Pebble, trails and a historic mission site on Keppel.

itinerary.title: West Point Island
itinerary.summary: An easy hike to albatross and rockhopper cliffs and a Falklands tea.

inclusions: Guided shore excursions, lectures and onboard entertainment
Buffet breakfast and lunch, a la carte dinner, wine, beer, soft drinks, coffee, tea and snacks
Loan of waterproof boots for landings
children: Sea voyages: minimum age 12, per Antarctica21's travel tips FAQ.
faqs: Which ship sails the Falklands voyage?
Magellan Explorer, the only ship listed for it.
